en: The Dyad of the Corrupt but Disjoined from the Defilements (Kilesavippayuttasaṅkilesikaduka)
Dependent on a state that is dissociated from the defilements and non-proclivous, a state that is dissociated from the defilements and non-proclivous arises by way of root condition.

Dependent on a state that is dissociated from the defilements and non-proclivous, a state that is dissociated from the defilements and not-non-proclivous arises by way of root condition. Dependent on a state that is dissociated from the defilements and non-proclivous...
Dependent on [a state] dissociated from defilements and non-defiled, states that are dissociated from defilements and non-defiled arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state dissociated from defilements and non-defiled, a state dissociated from defilements and non-defiled arises by way of root condition.

Dependent on a state that is dissociated from the defilements and not subject to defilement, and a state that is dissociated from the defilements and not subject to defilement, there arises a state that is dissociated from the defilements and not subject to defilement by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are five;
under the object condition there are two ... pe ... under the non-disappearance condition there are five. (Full detail for all.)
